About Crackbot

Independent. Community-driven. Defender-first.

Crackbot is a cybersecurity, digital forensics, threat intelligence and applied-AI research group focused on ethical research, responsible disclosure, open knowledge and collaboration.

Publish open research

Weekly technical posts and threat reports, annual white papers and original research recognized by the security community.

Build in the open

Open-source security and forensic tools, curated datasets, IOC feeds and research repositories anyone can use and audit.

Grow the community

Mentor students and aspiring researchers, collaborate with academia and industry, and share what we learn freely.

Our principles

Eight rules that gate every finding before publication.

ethics

Ethics Before Exploitation

We research to defend. Every technique we publish includes detection and mitigation guidance.

authorization

Authorization Before Testing

No unauthorized access. All research conducted in controlled environments or with explicit permission.

quality

Quality Over Quantity

One thorough analysis beats ten shallow write-ups. We optimize for depth and reproducibility.

evidence

Evidence Over Assumptions

Claims backed by artifacts — PCAPs, memory dumps, binaries, logs. Reproducibility is non-negotiable.

team-success

Team Success Over Individual Recognition

Credit is shared. Publications are collaborative. The group's reputation outlasts any single contribution.

learning

Continuous Learning

The threat landscape evolves daily. We invest in skill growth, tool mastery, and cross-domain knowledge.

collaboration

Open Collaboration

We build in the open. Tools, datasets, and methodologies are shared for collective defense.

disclosure

Respect for Privacy, Law & Responsible Disclosure

We operate within legal and ethical boundaries. Disclosure follows coordinated vulnerability disclosure best practices.

The team

A collaborative group of researchers, analysts and engineers. Individual profiles are published alongside the first attributed research releases.

Team Crackbot — operating across vulnerability research, malware analysis, DFIR and applied AI. We keep a low profile until the work speaks.
